compare_two_namespaces: run the script to compare two argparse.Namespace objects and show differences
list_unique_keys_ns1: run the script to list keys unique to the first namespace
list_unique_keys_ns2: run the script to list keys unique to the second namespace
find_different_values: run the script to find overlapping keys with different values between two namespaces
print_namespace_keys: run the script to print all non-private keys and values from a namespace
